caption: Ready always, with meekness and fear
alt: A lit lamp standing on a path at dawn beneath soft rays and a dove, hills in the distance.

caption: The heavens declare the glory of God
alt: A moon and scattered stars over dark hills, a lone tree standing beneath the night sky.

caption: Given by inspiration of God, and profitable
alt: An open Bible resting on a podium with a scroll and a lit candle beside it, golden light above.

caption: He is not here: for he is risen
alt: An empty tomb standing open before a rising sun at dawn, mountains behind.

caption: An anchor holding fast through the storm
alt: An anchor set firm above a stormy sea, distant thunder in a darkened sky.

caption: Not in word only, but in power
alt: A seven-branched lampstand burning brightly between two pillars in a hall, flame above.

caption: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine.
alt: Coins and a scale rest beside an open Bible under a golden, ray-lit sky, showing that all things belong to God.

caption: God loveth a cheerful giver.
alt: A sheaf of grain and a pile of coins are brought before a temple in the early dawn light.

caption: Whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
alt: A sheaf of grain stands beside a path leading toward a sunlit horizon, a picture of sowing and reaping.

caption: Godliness with contentment is great gain.
alt: A broken chain lies near a tree and a few coins, showing freedom from debt through honest work and contentment.

caption: Providing for honest things in the sight of men.
alt: A scale, coins, and a lamp rest on a table, showing money in the house of God handled openly and honestly.

caption: A prepared place, in the Father's house
alt: A golden sky over a shining city on a hill, with an open gate and a path leading toward it, and a dove flying above.

caption: Sown in weakness, raised in glory
alt: Dawn breaking over the holy city with the river of life flowing before it, an empty tomb to one side, and a trumpet sounding above.

caption: A great gulf fixed; a single light still holds
alt: A dim, stormy sky over the sea with a broken chain and a small lampstand near an anchor, restrained and without any figures.

caption: The books are opened; the crown is kept for the faithful
alt: A great hall with pillars and light streaming down on a set of scales, with a stack of books and a crown nearby.

caption: Treasure laid up, time redeemed, and the race endured
alt: A bright day over rolling hills with a path leading forward, an hourglass and a sheaf of grain beside it, and an open Bible in the foreground.

caption: A lamp on the path, and the Book beside it.
alt: A single lamp glowing on a quiet path at dusk beside an open Bible.

caption: Old errors return; the Word still stands between the pillars.
alt: A stack of ancient books between two pillars under a night sky with a single star.

caption: The crown that belongs to God alone.
alt: A golden crown haloed in light above a royal seal.

caption: Grace is the narrow door; endurance is the road beyond it.
alt: A narrow gate opening onto a path through a sunlit plain.

caption: The Spirit descends on still water at first light.
alt: A dove descending in the dawn light over still water before distant hills.

caption: A shield and the open Book, kept for the flock's sake.
alt: A shield resting beside an open Bible on a wooden table.

caption: Count the cost before the road, not on it.
alt: A single cross on a hilltop path at dawn, sunlight breaking over distant hills.

caption: Heaven opened to receive its faithful witness.
alt: A crown resting on open ground beneath a bright, opened sky with a scroll nearby.

caption: Of whom the world was not worthy.
alt: A broken chain beside a small steady lamp and an open Bible under a stormy sky.

caption: The grace for the hour is given in the hour.
alt: A seven-branched lampstand burning steadily at night beneath quiet stars, with a shield beside it.

caption: Faithful unto death, and He will give thee a crown of life.
alt: A golden crown glowing in radiant light, with an anchor below and a dove overhead.

caption: In the beginning was the Word
alt: A scroll rests on a path at dawn, light rays breaking over distant hills.

caption: The road set steadfastly toward Jerusalem
alt: A star shines over rolling hills with a path leading toward distant mountains.

caption: Power to be witnesses to the uttermost part of the earth
alt: A flame rests before a distant city, with a trumpet and scroll nearby on open ground.

caption: Behold, I make all things new
alt: A holy city glows at dawn above a crown, with a dove flying in the light.

caption: One book, one Author, one Redeemer
alt: An open Bible and an ancient scroll together on a path at dawn, with mountains in the distance and light breaking over the horizon.

caption: God teaches with pictures, and the pictures agree
alt: A chalice at the center of a table flanked by a lamp, a sheaf of grain, and a set of scales, under calm daylight.

caption: He did not begin at Bethlehem
alt: A flame burning on the desert ground at night beneath stars and distant mountains, unconsumed.

caption: Portraits God painted, not pictures we invented
alt: A doorway on a golden hillside beneath a crown of light, with a sheaf of grain nearby and mountains behind.

caption: The Spirit moved upon the face of the waters
alt: A dove hovering over dark storm-tossed water beneath heavy clouds, with distant thunder in the sky.

caption: Not one word of His promises will fall to the ground
alt: An hourglass and a six-pointed star before a distant city on the hills at dusk.

caption: Every day of the sixty-nine weeks came to pass
alt: A scroll lying on the floor of a hall between two pillars, before a temple in the background.

caption: A crown of glory that fadeth not away.
alt: A crown glows above a path winding through hills toward distant mountains, with an open Bible resting on the ground before it.

caption: Doctrine, fellowship, the breaking of bread, and prayers.
alt: A temple stands beyond an open gate, with an open Bible, bread, and a chalice set together below a dove flying in a clear sky.

caption: Preach Him first, and give Him the glory last.
alt: Golden light rays fall on a cross standing at the water's edge, with a dove flying above calm water.

caption: Wise as serpents, harmless as doves — joyful still.
alt: A single candle burns beside a broken chain on the floor under a stormy sky, with one star breaking through the clouds.

caption: Order, not a bag of tricks.
alt: A quiet hall with pillars, a podium, and a stack of books standing in ordered light.

caption: Equal weights for every side.
alt: A pair of balanced scales standing on an open plain under a golden sky, resting on a stack of books.

caption: One official version, sealed.
alt: A sealed scroll resting on a table beside a stack of books under a dusky sky.

caption: Turns measured by equal time.
alt: A podium and an hourglass standing side by side in a bright, pillared hall.

caption: Agree the logic; let it judge.
alt: A scroll and a lamp beside a pair of scales at dawn, marking the point that agreement settles.
